environment_notes: Linear PR history: each PR's merge_sha^1 equals the prior PR's merge_sha, so worktrees line up cleanly. Node v26.3.1, no deps needed -- suites are dependency-free per repo convention. Method used: for each linked test, copy the MERGE commit's test file onto the BASE worktree's code (overlay), then run it there for the RED check, and run the MERGE worktree's own test file at MERGE for the GREEN check. This is necessary because most of these tests are purely additive (new assertions appended to the same file) -- running each commit's own checked-out test file at that commit trivially passes at base (the new assertions aren't there yet) and proves nothing. Side effect: single-lane-build.test.js repeatedly crashes at base with a TDZ ReferenceError (PRs 53, 51, 49, 46) because its harness destructures function names out of an eval'd <<ROUTER>> region, and the merge test's destructure list names functions not yet present/ordered in base's router region -- a real, reproducible, deterministic failure, counted as red.
